claims.quote: Explicit falsification criteria are defined: the four-channel model is rejected if B_{3ch/4ch} > 100 AND f_AIC < 0.01 (95% upper limit); AIC is 'detected' only if its 95% lower bound exceeds 0.005 AND B_{with/without AIC} > 30.
claims.note: 给出了明确的观测量（Bayes factor B、混合分数 f_AIC 的 95% 可信区间上下界）、具体阈值（B>100、B>30、f_AIC<0.01、f_AIC>0.005）与否证/确认条件，读者可据此判断何种结果将推翻假设。

claims.quote: AIC is treated as a theoretical channel whose existence is to be tested rather than assumed; its mixing fraction f_AIC is assigned a prior centred near zero with a wide tail, so that the data must positively require it for the four-channel model to be preferred.
claims.note: 明确将 AIC 设为待检验假设，并说明数据必须正面要求该通道存在才会被采纳，符合可证伪性要求。

claims.quote: CCSNe produce the highest birth rate and the broadest kick-velocity distribution (mean ≳ 300 km/s) and therefore dominate the young, high-velocity tail of the pulsar population [1806.07267; 2412.08446; 2002.01367].
claims.note: 从 CCSN 的出生率与踢速度分布推导出其主导年轻高速脉冲星群体，逻辑链条完整且有引用支撑。

claims.quote: EC-SNe are predicted to impart small natal kicks (≲ 50 km/s), so their neutron stars remain in wide, nearly circular orbits — a signature observed in DNS systems where six of eight known Galactic disk DNS binaries have e < 0.27 [0704.1215; 2205.03989].
claims.note: 从 EC-SN 小踢速度→宽近圆轨道→DNS 偏心率观测特征，每一步都有引用。

claims.quote: AIC is a theoretically predicted channel [1406.4128] that should produce millisecond pulsars on long, highly circular orbits (e < 0.1, P_orb > 2 d) [1901.00547], but no direct detection of an AIC event exists; it must therefore be treated as a hypothesis to be tested.
claims.note: 从 AIC 理论预测→可观测特征→尚无直接探测→必须作为待检验假设，推导链完整。

claims.quote: Globular clusters retain neutron stars and dynamically assemble millisecond pulsars through exchange encounters and tidal captures [0711.3001], producing a population distinguishable by its spatial concentration, high MSP fraction, and distinct spin/orbital distributions [2111.14084].
claims.note: 从 GC 动力学过程→可区分的观测特征，推导清晰并有引用。

claims.quote: The expanding DNS sample [1904.12745] and the growing catalogue of pulsar proper motions [2002.01367] now make it feasible to use natal kick velocities and orbital eccentricities — jointly — as primary observables in a hierarchical Bayesian mixture model
claims.note: 从数据样本扩张→可行性论证，衔接自然。

claims.quote: Catalog compilation: Assemble a unified pulsar catalogue with v_kick (from proper motions/parallaxes), orbital parameters (e, P_orb) for all known DNS and binary pulsars, spin/B, and environmental classification (field vs. GC).
claims.note: 数据集来源明确：ATNF Pulsar Catalog + PSRπ + DNS 文献 + GC 脉冲星目录 + AIC 暂现源巡天上限。

claims.quote: Hierarchical Bayesian inference: Use nested sampling (MultiNest/dynesty) to infer mixing fractions and channel-specific parameters for the four-channel mixture and all nested sub-models (3-channel, 2-channel, field-only); compute Bayes factors.
claims.note: 算法实名（MultiNest/dynesty），基线实名（单通道 CCSN、2 通道 CCSN+ECSN、3 通道无 AIC、非参 KDE），指标可量化（log Z、Bayes factor 阈值、KS 统计量、95% 可信区间）。

claims.quote: Channel-specific forward models: Implement forward models for (v_kick, e, P_orb) incorporating common-envelope and second-SN physics; validate against population-synthesis mock catalogues.
claims.note: 前向模型物理依据明确（共同包层 [2001.09829]、第二次 SN 踢 [1904.06137]），并通过 mock catalog 验证。

claims.quote: Bayes factor thresholds: B > 100 for decisive rejection, B > 30 for strong evidence
claims.note: 指标阈值明确，可直接用于排期与判定。

claims.quote: CCSNe produce the highest birth rate and the broadest kick-velocity distribution (mean ≳ 300 km/s) ... [1806.07267; 2412.08446; 2002.01367].
claims.note: Card 1 (1806.07267) 给出 CCSN 主导与踢速度分布；Card 6 (2002.01367) 给出 PSRπ 平均速度数百 km/s；Card 7 (2412.08446) 将踢速度与形成通道关联，三条引用共同支撑该论断。

claims.quote: six of eight known Galactic disk DNS binaries have e < 0.27 [0704.1215; 2205.03989]
claims.note: Card 3 (0704.1215) 明确给出 'Six of the eight ... e < 0.27'；Card 2 (2205.03989) 将 EC-SN 与低偏心率宽轨道直接关联，引用与论断严格对应。

claims.note: Card 4 (1406.4128) 明确 'never been a direct detection'；Card 5 (1901.00547) 给出 'P_orb > 2 d' 与 'e < 0.1' 的可观测预测，引用与论断一一对应。

claims.quote: Globular clusters retain neutron stars and dynamically assemble millisecond pulsars through exchange encounters and tidal captures [0711.3001], producing a population distinguishable by its spatial concentration, high MSP fraction, and distinct spin/orbital distributions [2111.14084].
claims.note: Card 8 (0711.3001) 与 Card 9 (2111.14084) 分别支撑动力学形成机制与可区分观测特征，引用与论断匹配。

claims.quote: The forward model for binary observables incorporates common-envelope physics [2001.09829] and second-supernova kick prescriptions [1904.06137]
claims.note: Card 12 (2001.09829) 提供共同包层物理；Card 11 (1904.06137) 提供第二次 SN 踢对 DNS 系统速度与轨道的影响，引用精准对应。

claims.quote: the AIC component receives a conservative prior f_AIC ~ Beta(1, 20) centred near zero, reflecting its status as an unconfirmed theoretical prediction [1406.4128].
claims.note: Beta(1,20) 是方法学选择，其合理性由 1406.4128 中 AIC 未被观测证实的状态支撑，引用与论断对应。
